description: Use this when the user asks about one app's ad spend, installs, revenue, ROAS or cost per install across ad networks. One app's spend, installs, trials, revenue, ROAS and cost per install, per day and per network (with an 'all' total per day) or per campaign, joined from Apptiller's synced history. Every number names its source: spend from the ad platforms; installs from the attribution layer (Apptiller's AdServices lookup for Apple Ads, the MMP for other networks), falling back to what the network claims, then to the revenue tool's tags; revenue, and so ROAS, from the MMP from the first day it has revenue for the app (revenue from the installs it attributed, USD, by install day; zeros mean the network earned nothing), else from the revenue tool's acquisition tags, whose split then sits in revenue_elsewhere; new customers and trials from the revenue tool, whose customers with no acquisition tag form an 'untagged' row (unknown source, not organic). Apple's own counts from App Store Connect sit beside each day's total in the network breakdown: first-time downloads in installs_elsewhere and proceeds (after Apple's commission, net of refunds) in revenue_elsewhere, standing in only on days no other layer counts; appleads rows carry app_store_search, Apple's count of all App Store search downloads, organic and Apple Ads together. Meta web campaigns (aimed at leads, sales or traffic, not app installs) carry web_results: the sign-ups, purchases and purchase value Meta's pixel counted on the website, Meta's own claim; they have no installs, the MMP doesn't judge them, and Meta's purchase value is their revenue only where the revenue tool has none tagged to them. ROAS only where spend and revenue share a currency. Set per_day false for one row per network or campaign over the whole range.
name: app_performance
title: App performance by day
